question: What were the top 5 product categories by revenue across all channels in 2002?
sql:
WITH store_rev AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_category AS category,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS rev
  FROM store_sales AS ss
  JOIN item AS i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2002 AND NOT i.i_category IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.i_category
), catalog_rev AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_category AS category,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS rev
  FROM catalog_sales AS cs
  JOIN item AS i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2002 AND NOT i.i_category IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.i_category
), web_rev AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_category AS category,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS rev
  FROM web_sales AS ws
  JOIN item AS i
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2002 AND NOT i.i_category IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.i_category
)
SELECT
  category AS product_category,
  ROUND(SUM(rev), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    category,
    rev
  FROM store_rev
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    category,
    rev
  FROM catalog_rev
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    category,
    rev
  FROM web_rev
) AS combined
GROUP BY
  category
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly store revenue and web revenue side by side for 2001.
sql:
WITH store_rev AS (
  SELECT
    d_moy AS month_no,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_rev
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    date_dim.d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY
    d_moy
), web_rev AS (
  SELECT
    d_moy AS month_no,
    SUM(ws_net_paid) AS web_rev
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim
    ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    date_dim.d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY
    d_moy
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(store_rev.month_no, web_rev.month_no) AS month_no,
  ROUND(COALESCE(store_rev.store_rev, 0), 2) AS store_revenue,
  ROUND(COALESCE(web_rev.web_rev, 0), 2) AS web_revenue
FROM store_rev
FULL OUTER JOIN web_rev
  ON store_rev.month_no = web_rev.month_no
ORDER BY
  month_no
LIMIT 500

question: What are the top 5 return reasons by total return amount across all channels?
sql:
WITH store AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS amt
  FROM store_returns AS sr
  JOIN reason AS r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY
    r.r_reason_desc
), catalog AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS amt
  FROM catalog_returns AS cr
  JOIN reason AS r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY
    r.r_reason_desc
), web AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS amt
  FROM web_returns AS wr
  JOIN reason AS r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY
    r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
  r_reason_desc AS return_reason,
  ROUND(SUM(amt), 2) AS total_return_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    r_reason_desc,
    amt
  FROM store
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    r_reason_desc,
    amt
  FROM catalog
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    r_reason_desc,
    amt
  FROM web
) AS t
GROUP BY
  r_reason_desc
ORDER BY
  total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

question: What is the store return rate (units returned divided by units sold) for each product category?
sql:
SELECT
  category,
  ROUND(return_rate, 2) AS return_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    sc.i_category AS category,
    COALESCE(rc.units_returned, 0) / sc.units_sold AS return_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      i.i_category,
      SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN item AS i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY
      i.i_category
  ) AS sc
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      i.i_category,
      SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS units_returned
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN item AS i
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY
      i.i_category
  ) AS rc
    ON rc.i_category = sc.i_category
  WHERE
    NOT sc.i_category IS NULL
) AS result
ORDER BY
  return_rate DESC
LIMIT 500

question: What percentage of total 2002 revenue came from each sales channel?
sql:
WITH channel_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'store' AS channel,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS net_revenue
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d_year = 2002
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'catalog',
    SUM(cs_net_paid)
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim
    ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d_year = 2002
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'web',
    SUM(ws_net_paid)
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim
    ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d_year = 2002
), total_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM channel_totals
)
SELECT
  channel,
  ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(net_revenue / total_revenue.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM channel_totals
CROSS JOIN total_revenue
ORDER BY
  percentage DESC
LIMIT 501

question: For products from manufacturer 128, what were in-store gross sales by year and brand, counting only November sales? Show brand ID, brand and sales, top 100 by year then sales.

clarifications.question: Which attribute represents the manufacturer (or does the request refer to brand 128)? Please specify so I can provide the correct query.

sql:
WITH sales_by_brand AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_manufact_id AS brand_id,
    i.i_manufact AS brand_name,
    d.d_year AS year,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS gross_sales
  FROM store_sales AS ss
  JOIN item AS i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_moy = 11 AND i.i_manufact_id = 128
  GROUP BY
    i.i_manufact_id,
    i.i_manufact,
    d.d_year
), ranked_sales AS (
  SELECT
    brand_id,
    brand_name,
    year,
    gross_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY gross_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
  FROM sales_by_brand
)
SELECT
  brand_id,
  brand_name,
  year,
  ROUND(gross_sales, 2) AS gross_sales,
  sales_rank
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE
  sales_rank <= 100
ORDER BY

question: For single, college-educated men in 2000, excluding purchases where the promotion ran by both email and event, what were the average quantity, list price, coupon amount and sales price per product ID in store sales? Show the first 100 product IDs alphabetically.
sql:
WITH sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ss.ss_list_price,
    ss.ss_coupon_amt,
    ss.ss_sales_price,
    i.i_item_id,
    dm.cd_marital_status,
    dm.cd_gender,
    dm.cd_education_status,
    p.p_channel_email,
    p.p_channel_event
  FROM store_sales AS ss
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item AS i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN promotion AS p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics AS dm
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = dm.cd_demo_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year = 2000
    AND dm.cd_marital_status = 'S'
    AND dm.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND dm.cd_education_status = 'College'
    AND NOT (
      p.p_channel_email = 'Y' AND p.p_channel_event = 'Y'
    )
)
SELECT
  i_item_id AS product_id,
  ROUND(AVG(ss_quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
  ROUND(AVG(ss_list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price,
  ROUND(AVG(ss_coupon_amt), 2) AS avg_coupon_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(ss_sales_price), 2) AS avg_sales_price
FROM sales_filtered
GROUP BY
  i_item_id
ORDER BY
  product_id
LIMIT 100

question: Which product category had the largest increase in store revenue from 2001 to 2002?
sql:
WITH revenue_by_cat_year AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_category AS category,
    d.d_year AS year,
    ROUND(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 2) AS revenue
  FROM store_sales AS ss
  JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item AS i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  GROUP BY
    i.i_category,
    d.d_year
), revenue_2001 AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    revenue AS rev_2001
  FROM revenue_by_cat_year
  WHERE
    year = 2001
), revenue_2002 AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    revenue AS rev_2002
  FROM revenue_by_cat_year
  WHERE
    year = 2002
), diff AS (
  SELECT
    r2001.category,
    r2001.rev_2001,
    r2002.rev_2002,
    ROUND(r2002.rev_2002 - r2001.rev_2001, 2) AS revenue_increase
  FROM revenue_2001 AS r2001
  JOIN revenue_2002 AS r2002
    ON r2001.category = r2002.category
)
SELECT
  category,
  rev_2001,
  rev_2002,
  revenue_increase
FROM diff
ORDER BY
  revenue_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
